description: Run the check of a host or service now instead of at its next interval, for example after a fix. Waits for the new result and returns the state it gives.

hostname.description: Exact host name. Required - there is no estate-wide form of this tool. A name that matches no host is answered with the tools that can find the right one.

servicename.description: Exact service name on that host. Empty: check the host.

with_services.description: For a host: also check all its services now.

name: reschedule_check
title: Check Now
